label: LINE
terms_note: LINE Official Account with a Messaging API channel; Authorization: Bearer <channel access token>. Reply (free, webhook replyToken), push (one user; X-Line-Retry-Key header), multicast (≤500 user ids), narrowcast (segments), broadcast (all friends) — push / multicast / narrowcast / broadcast count toward the plan's monthly message quota ('the number of free messages depends on the subscription plan'). Rate limits per channel per endpoint: send 2,000 requests / second, get content 2,000 / s, broadcast 60 / hour, narrowcast 60 / hour, others 2,000 / s. Groups: the OA is invited by users (cannot create a group), can read group summary / member count / member profiles and leave; 'the bot cannot send messages to groups it is not a member of'. Mark-as-read and loading-animation endpoints exist. Inbound is webhook-only (X-Line-Signature HMAC-SHA256) — no history endpoint.

sdks: Official LINE Messaging API SDKs (Java, PHP, Python, Node.js, Go, Ruby) — developers.line.biz

endpoints.notes: free (not counted); reply token single-use, short-lived
2,000 / s multicast (client note: 200 / s); broadcast + narrowcast **60 / hour**
OA is invited by users — cannot create a group; cannot post to a group it is not in

reference.limits: - Quota: "the number of free messages depends on the subscription plan of your LINE Official Account" — push / multicast / narrowcast / broadcast consume it, replies do not. - Message objects: text ≤ 5,000 chars, image / video by HTTPS URL, Flex, template, sticker, location; ≤ 5 per call. - Rate limits per channel per endpoint as in the table; 429 → `RateLimited`.

fields.name: channel_access_token
fields.help: Channel access token of the Messaging API channel (long-lived token from the LINE Developers Console, or a short-lived / v2.1 token), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {channel access token}' (securitySchemes Bearer 'Channel access token' in LINE's official OpenAPI description, https://github.com/line/line-openapi/blob/main/messaging-api.yml; https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#send-push-message).

adapter.rate_note: Push messages are counted against the plan's monthly message quota and answered 429 Too Many Requests above the per-endpoint rate limit (https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#rate-limits — the section is rendered client-side and could not be read headlessly, so its per-endpoint numbers are UNCONFIRMED here); the client bucket stays at the runtime default 2/s. X-Line-Retry-Key (an idempotency UUID) is not sent.

me.note: 'Get bot info' — account carries userId ('Bot's user ID'), basicId, premiumId, displayName, pictureUrl, chatMode (chat | bot) and markAsReadMode (auto | manual).

send.note: 'Sends a message to a user, group chat, or multi-person chat at any time': `to` is the userId, groupId or roomId ('ID of the receiver'), `text` becomes messages[0] = {type: 'text', text} ('Max character limit: 5000'); `subject` and `channel` are ignored. Users must have added the LINE Official Account (or share the group / room) and push messages consume the plan's monthly quota. message_id is sentMessages[0].id ('ID of the sent message'); quoteToken sits under raw.sentMessages[0].

not_offered.reply: POST /v2/bot/message/reply needs the single-use, short-lived `replyToken` of the webhook event being answered (not a conversation id); nothing in the reply input carries it (https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#send-reply-message).
not_offered.list_inbound: The Messaging API has no message-history endpoint: inbound messages are delivered only to the channel's webhook URL (https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#webhooks).
not_offered.get_thread: No conversation or history resource exists; only media content of a webhook-delivered message can be fetched (GET https://api-data.line.me/v2/bot/message/{messageId}/content, https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#get-content).
not_offered.mark_read: POST /v2/bot/chat/markAsRead requires a `markAsReadToken` delivered in the webhook event ('Tokens must be used by the bot that received them via Webhook'), which none of the mark_read inputs carries (https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#mark-as-read).
